question: Can a bounded external learner deform fourteen supplied labelled seed points to a simple rational polygon whose odd labels form a five-point degenerate Pascal construction with one point at infinity, and whose even labels form a four-point degenerate Pascal construction? Additionally the four-point circle center must lie exactly on the five-point circle.
level: External exact rational geometry and bounded parameter learning; no native semantic admission or generic native learn command.

sources.external_seed: An explicit external JSON path; seed bytes and source figures are not silently downloaded, embedded, or published by this experiment.
sources.reuse: experiments/knowledge_geometry/acceleration_direction.py: cross and det3; Research 0131 proposal/check/judgment/update/retention discipline

imported_assumptions: The Euclidean rational plane embeds into the real plane and the projective plane.
Pascal incidence for a nonsingular conic has tangent limits at adjacent repeated points.
The rational parametrization ((1-t*t)/(1+t*t), 2*t/(1+t*t)) lies on the unit circle.
Floating optimization proposes only; Python Fraction arithmetic and an independently implemented checker determine acceptance.
protected: Exactly fourteen distinct rational finite points, preserving label identity and cyclic polygon boundary order.
Specified four/five circle membership, positive circle radii, nonzero tangent/chord lines and projective intersections.
Actual intersection-to-label bindings, not merely the tautological Pascal collinearity residual.
Exactly one red infinity point, three distinct Pascal intersections per circle, and a simple polygon of nonzero area.
No tolerance, rounded coordinate, score improvement, or claimed success flag overrides exact checks.
Squared distance between the blue and red centers equals the red squared radius exactly.
All pairwise squared distances exceed 1/40000 in seed coordinate units at acceptance.
released: Original Tile edge lengths, angles, circle centers and radii.
The original straight-angle point 10 may leave the blue circle and bend.
Tiling, aperiodicity, rigidity, similarity to Tile, global optimality, and native Adva learning are not claimed.
No continuous feasible path from the original seed to the final candidate is claimed.
objective: Fit the supplied labelled seed in a seven-angle family with coupled circles. The first six angles choose two Pascal configurations; the seventh locates the blue center on the red unit circle. Joint complex least squares determines C,q,s, with red points C+q*r and blue points C+q*k+s*b. Rationalize C,q,s,k-chart and reconstruct all points and the blue center exactly.
acceptance: Independent exact checker accepts the complete reconstructed rational candidate; otherwise retain Refuted or Unknown and its reason. Search exhaustion is not nonexistence.
negative_controls: Independent center-incidence failure of the earlier v0 candidate
authority: No stable core changes, machine/library lock updates, math catalog successor, native Pascal import, Q4/M6 certificate, or Seal.
